title: Laptop RTX 5090 Runs Circles Around M5 Max In Prompt Processing & Token Generation With Up To 133% Faster Performance, Until Bigger LLMs Or Context Length Come Into Play
summary: Laptop RTX 5090 Runs Circles Around M5 Max In Prompt Processing & Token Generation With Up To 133% Faster Performance, Until Bigger LLMs Or Context Length Come Into Play Wccftech
body: Laptop RTX 5090 Runs Circles Around M5 Max In Prompt Processing & Token Generation With Up To 133% Faster Performance, Until Bigger LLMs Or Context Length Come Into Play Wccftech
summaryZh: 文章对比了笔记本电脑搭载的RTX 5090显卡与M5 Max芯片在处理大型语言模型（LLM）任务时的性能表现。结果显示，在提示处理和令牌生成方面，RTX 5090的性能最高可达M5 Max的133%。然而，当处理更大的LLM模型或更长的上下文长度时，这种性能优势可能会受到限制，表明硬件性能与模型规模和复杂度之间的权衡。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该内容对比了不同硬件在处理LLM任务时的性能差异，对硬件选型有参考价值。
